theme: 3 terms on structs and classes: copy or share in Swift

terms.definition: A type that groups related values together and is copied whenever you pass it around.
terms.example: Make the point a struct, so each screen gets its own copy.

terms.definition: A type that groups related values together and is shared, so every variable points to the same object.
terms.example: Make the player a class, so every screen sees the same score.

terms.definition: A type that is copied each time you assign it, so changing the copy never changes the original.
terms.example: A struct is a value type, so editing the copy is safe.

video.title: Struct, Class & Value Type in 2 minutes | iOS Daily English Day 8
video.description:
Learn to talk about structs and classes in Swift: Struct, Class and Value Type, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Struct - A type that groups related values together and is copied whenever you pass it around.
Class - A type that groups related values together and is shared, so every variable points to the same object.
Value Type - A type that is copied each time you assign it, so changing the copy never changes the original.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 8 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: Swift Struct, Class & Value Type in English | Copy vs Share Chat | Day 8
landscape.description:
Explain Struct, Class and Value Type in Swift by listening to a real bug-fix chat between two iOS devs.
구조체, 클래스, 값 타입 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Struct - A type that groups related values together and is copied whenever you pass it around.
한국어: 관련된 값을 묶고 전달할 때마다 복사되는 타입

Class - A type that groups related values together and is shared, so every variable points to the same object.
한국어: 관련된 값을 묶고 공유되어 모두 같은 객체를 가리키는 타입

Value Type - A type that is copied each time you assign it, so changing the copy never changes the original.
한국어: 대입할 때마다 복사되어 원본이 바뀌지 않는 타입

In this video, Mina and Jake find out why a copied session changed, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

dialogue.title: Why did the copy change?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I copied the session, but the old one changed too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: `Session` is a class, so both variables share the same object.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How do I get a real copy?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Use a struct. A struct is a value type, so every variable gets its own copy when you assign it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not for copies. Use a struct for data you copy, and a class only when you really need sharing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Got it. I will use a value type for copies, and a class for sharing.
Make it a struct, so each screen gets its own copy.
